title: California police officer pulls 18-year-old from burning Mercedes after train collision; bodycam captures rescue
summary_full: An 18-year-old driver was trapped in a burning Mercedes-Benz after a collision with an Amtrak train. Police officers quickly arrived at the scene and pulled the unconscious driver from the wreckage. The rescue was completed in less than a minute, despite the risk of explosion. Firefighters worked to control the flames while medical personnel transported the driver to a local hospital.
